_provenance.source: Prism public API — research.evidence (one call per angle) + research.brief
_provenance.note: Counts and shares measured from the data. Effect sizes copied verbatim and verified against source. 'reading' is Prism's interpretation of the slice, not a verdict on truth. Thin claim lanes are reported inconclusive, not charted.

angles.reading: overwhelmingly positive framing, which on a citation-weighted corpus can mean consensus or can mean publication bias

angles.claim: intermittent fasting increases the risk of hypoglycaemia in type 2 diabetes
angles.note: automated lane over-resolved to the diabetes field; read from documents. Corley 2018 RCT: RR 2.05 (1.17-3.52); INTERFAST-2 (Obermayer 2023): no severe hypoglycemia; Ramadan review: conflicting results
